DESIGN FIX CONFIRMED: YOU'RE IN! (52px, font-weight:900, uppercase) hero header, VIEW TICKETS dark (#111827) CTA button, event image inside card (not as full-width header), per-ticket QR cards.
FEE BREAKDOWN CONFIRMED: Subtotal, Platform Cost, Stripe Fee, Tax rows shown (non-zero only) + Total Paid bold row.
FOOTER CONFIRMED: 'Organized by <organizer> • Powered by OpenTicket'.
STRIPE CONTROLLER CONFIRMED: passes image_url (line 1036) and description (line 1037) to emailService, passes stripe_fee (line 1047) to orderDetails.
SERVER EMAIL CONFIRMED: maps eventDetails?.image_url to eventImageUrl (line 97), passes stripeFee: orderDetails.stripeFee || 0 (line 105).
OTHER EMAILS UNAFFECTED: presaleSignupConfirmation and eventReminder still use universalEmailWrapper wrapper unchanged - confirmed by valid HTML and correct structure.

rca_of_issues.ticket_price_zero_bug: Old code used t.price which was $0 (not set correctly on ticket objects). Fixed: code now uses t.pricePerTicket || t.price || 0, and stripeController/serverEmail both pass pricePerTicket in ticket objects.
rca_of_issues.null_qr_code_bug: Old code passed null as qrCodeBaseUrl, resulting in gray placeholder div. Fixed: new code constructs full QR URL directly from ticket ID using api.qrserver.com.
rca_of_issues.unprofessional_design: Old template lacked branding. Fixed: new purchaseConfirmation has dedicated HTML (not using universalEmailWrapper) with YOU'RE IN! hero, event image, per-ticket cards, fee table, OpenTicket logo header, and organizer footer.
